mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have a temperature of 64 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School. We are currently experiencing a new moon, and although the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona recently reached a milestone as the Common Council unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-range document, developed with extensive public feedback, focuses on housing, sustainability, and supporting our regional employment hubs. Additionally, the city continues to provide ongoing engineering and public works updates available on the municipal website.

We have a great lineup for our community. Today, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, there are multiple options for trivia including at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market will be at Hometown Junction Park on October 14.
Regarding the police department's weekly recap, on October 3, an officer located a 19-year-old man driving with expired registration who was found to be in possession of a stolen firearm.

Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach, which is a delicious choice to celebrate the day. Please note that the store is currently closed, but it opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
